title: 4moji construction and icon field

location.extent: Published video poster; complete local video linked

slide_intent: Connect playful symbols through a shared drawing language, because varied meanings still need to feel like one family.
strategic_value: The gridded devil face and repeated outlined icons can extend Channel 4’s mischievous character beyond its main logo.
demonstration: The four-second clip moves from a close view of a devil-face icon on construction guides to rows of outlined icons on green and white fields; New and Stream appear among the icons near the end.
practical_value: Compare construction consistency and inline word/icon relationships before expanding an expressive icon family.

content_islands.name: Construction reveal
content_islands.spec: Begin with the devil-face details and reveal the full face over blue guides and a gray grid.

content_islands.name: Icon field
content_islands.spec: Move through rows of black outlined symbols on green, then white backgrounds.

content_islands.name: Type integration
content_islands.spec: Insert New and Stream among the final icon rows to show the symbols sharing space with text.

reference_purposes.Intent: Pentagram’s accompanying case study identifies 4mojis as playful moments integrated into the brand typefaces so functionality does not drown out its mischievousness.
reference_purposes.Expression: The four-second clip moves from a close view of a devil-face icon on construction guides to rows of outlined icons on green and white fields; New and Stream appear among the icons near the end.
reference_purposes.Application: The source demonstrates this treatment in a construction-and-use sequence that places icons beside words.

ingredient.name: 4moji icons
ingredient.role: Add expressive cues within the brand’s functional graphic language.
ingredient.application: Keep the illustrated symbols visually coordinated and compare them beside words as the clip does.
ingredient.scope: Observed construction and use in the 2023 case study. The construction grid is shown without a transferable numeric specification.
